## CROSS-CUTTING CONFLICT SUMMARY FOR MERGING

### CRITICAL (will cause visual breakage)

1. **`.case-card`** -- Defined differently in 13-five-cases.html (colored gradient bar) and 20-global-cases.html (bordered white card with shadow and gradient top border). **Guaranteed breakage on at least one slide.**

2. **`.page-footer`** -- 06-data.html redefines `.page-footer` locally. In a single-file merge, this would override the tokens.css version and potentially affect ALL slides that depend on the shared `.page-footer`.

3. **`.tag` / `.tag-green` / `.tag-orange` / `.tag-blue`** -- 34-before-after.html defines its own versions with different `padding`, `border-radius`, and `font-size` than tokens.css. In a single file, whichever loads last wins, breaking the other.

### HIGH (will likely cause unintended inheritance)

4. **`.num`** -- Appears in 13-five-cases (`.insight-card .num`), 30-three-levels (`.judgement .num`), and 43-closing (`.sector-label .num`). While contextually namespaced to different parents, a bare `.num` selector anywhere would affect all of them.

5. **`.item`** -- Appears in 02-opening (`.side .item`) and 34-before-after (`.panel .item`). Different parents, so no direct conflict, but any slide adding a bare `.item` class would inherit from whoever defines it first.

6. **Body display cascade** -- All slides redeclare `display: flex; flex-direction: column;` but with different `gap` and `align-items` values. The tokens.css default body has no `gap` and no `align-items`. In a single file, the body rule in each slide's `<style>` tag would need to be scoped to that slide.

### MEDIUM (inconsistencies and overhead)

7. **`@import` in slide-system.css** -- The `@import url("tokens.css")` inside slide-system.css fetches tokens.css a second time on the 5 slides that link to both files. In a single HTML file, this would either be a separate HTTP request or would need to be inlined.

8. **`.part-cover` double definition** -- Defined in both tokens.css and slide-system.css with different styles. The slide-system.css version is more elaborate and uses a gradient background. In a merge, the last-defined wins.

9. **`.part-cover` structural inconsistency** -- part1-cover puts `.part-num`/`.part-title`/`.part-sub`/`.part-divider` at the body level, while part6-cover nests them inside a `.part-cover` div. These are structurally incompatible DOM patterns.

10. **Inconsistent page title class names** -- Slides use either `.slide-title` (from slide-system.css, used by 03/15/20) or `.page-title` (self-defined, used by 06/13/30/34), and 01-cover/02-opening use their own custom names (`.cover-title`, `.hero-quote`). No consistent title class across the deck.

11. **Various similar footer/quote patterns** -- `.foot-kicker` (02, 03), `.foot-quote` (15, 30), `.formula-bar` (34), `.closing-line` (43), `.kicker` (slide-system.css) -- all serve similar purposes but are named differently.

### LOW (potential specificity issues)

12. **`.hl`** -- Used in 01-cover, 02-opening, 03-policy-chain, 30-three-levels, 34-before-after, 43-closing. All define it as `color: var(--brand-blue)` which is consistent, but it's defined in each slide's `<style>` separately.

13. **Generic short class names** -- `.c1` through `.c5` (13-five-cases), `.s1` through `.s5` (43-closing), `.l1`/`.l2`/`.l3` (30-three-levels), `.a1`/`.a2`/`.a3`/`.a4` (43-closing), `.hl` -- these are 1-2 character class names that are highly likely to collide or leak between slides.

14. **Numeric class names** -- `.bar-1` through `.bar-6` (03-policy-chain), `.c1`-`.c5` (13-five-cases), `.s1`-`.s5` (43-closing), `.l1`-`.l3` (30-three-levels), `.a1`-`.a4` (43-closing). While most are parent-contextually scoped, they increase the risk surface.

### RECOMMENDATIONS FOR SINGLE-FILE MERGE

1. **Namespace every slide's CSS** -- Either wrap each slide's `<style>` in a slide-specific selector (e.g., `.slide-01`) or use a bundler that scopes CSS to the slide's root element.

2. **Resolve `.case-card` before merge** -- Decide whether to rename the class in 13-five-cases or 20-global-cases, or merge the styles.

3. **Remove 06-data.html's `.page-footer` override** -- It should inherit from tokens.css instead.

4. **Resolve `.tag-*` conflict** -- Decide whether 34-before-after should use tokens.css tag classes or keep its own. They are visually different (rounded pill vs. slightly rounded inline).

5. **Align part-cover structure** -- Make part1-cover use the `.part-cover` wrapper like part6-cover does, instead of having classes at body level.

6. **Fix `@import` duplication** -- In the single file, inline tokens.css content once rather than having it imported twice.

7. **Standardize page title** -- Use either `.slide-title` (from slide-system.css) or `.page-title` consistently across all slides that have a title.

8. **Rename short/numeric class names** -- `.c1`-`.c5`, `.s1`-`.s5`, `.l1`-`.l3`, `.a1`-`.a4` should be prefixed to prevent cross-slide leakage.
